item.name: Hostname
item.description: The hostname of the SMTP gateway

item.name: Port
item.description: The port of the SMTP gateway

item.name: TLS
item.description: Indicates whether the SMPT gateway communication will use TLS

item.name: TLS Trust
item.description: A space separated list of hostnames or IP addresses which should be trusted when using SSL/TLS (Use * to trust all hosts as a last resort, always provide a list of hosts/IPs)

item.name: TLS Check Server Identity
item.description: Indicates whether the server identity should be checked when using SSL/TLS (use false for accepting or self-signed certificates with incorrect hostnames)

item.name: User Name
item.description: The username used to access the SMTP gateway

item.name: Password
item.description: The password used to access the SMTP gateway

item.name: From
item.description: The 'from' field for all emails going out

item.name: Maximum Retry Count
item.description: The maximum number of retry attempts in case of failures

item.name: Retention
item.description: The retention of emails already sent out
